name: 32937 · Satellite Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 32937 (Satellite Bch) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32937 (Satellite Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
